messages:
sara-sales: Heads up — POC customer reported embeddings responses truncated mid-sentence for a ~1.2MB document set. They don't get a 413 from their proxy. They say the same payload used to work with a different vendor.

eli-eng: Do we have raw headers/body sample? Suspect encoding mismatch.

sara-sales: They pasted this snippet: 
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16
Content-Length: 1203456

{... large JSON ...}
They mentioned a legacy Java client that emits UTF-16.

kevin-ml: UTF-16 doubles bytes for ASCII; our pipeline assumes UTF-8 and performs byte-based token heuristics. If decoding fails we can hit truncation.

maya-se: Confirmed in parser logs: invalid UTF-8 sequences cause the streaming reader to stop and mark payload truncated. Our streaming limiter checks bytes after decoding to UTF-8.

infra-bot: ingress-log: parsing error at bytes=65536, handler=request-body-limiter, code=PAYLOAD_TRUNCATED

kevin-ml: The log shows we hit a chunk boundary at 64KB and saw invalid continuation bytes. Likely their Content-Length and actual decoded bytes mismatch.

maya-se: Short-term mitigations to give customer:
1) Re-encode JSON as UTF-8 (remove charset or set charset=utf-8).
2) Send compressed body and set Content-Encoding: gzip — our edge will decompress before enforcing size checks.
3) Split document into semantic chunks <=256k and call embeddings in parallel.

eli-eng: Also advise removing any UTF-16 BOM (0xFFFE) as some parsers choke. If they can run `iconv -f utf-16 -t utf-8` on their file that's best.

liz-shipit: Sales note: chunking increases API call count — will impact cost. I can prepare a quick cost/throughput estimate if they choose chunking.

kevin-ml: For hosted POCs we can't relax global truncation. For Dedicated we can apply per-tenant policy, but this customer is on hosted. We could offer a temporary proxy re-encoding step internally if they share a redacted repro.

maya-se: If they still see issues after re-encoding, request a minimal curl reproducible example and a redacted payload file so eng can run it against the edge. Specific ask: `curl -v --data-binary @file --header "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8"` and attach the exact file bytes.

sara-sales: I gave the three workarounds and asked them to test tomorrow. They asked whether we can waive truncation just for their org for the POC.

eli-eng: Not possible on hosted. Offer the proxy or gzip route. Also note vendor differences — some providers automatically coerce encodings, others don't. Recommend UTF-8 normalization for portability.

sara-sales: Great, i'll follow up and escalate if they provide a repro. Will open a swarming thread with eng if needed. :thumbsup:
